title: Unit-Counting Methods and the Time-Delivered Ratio on Non-Covered Insured Plan of Care Visits
content:
**Compliance note — Insured Plan of Care.** The rate for a non-covered visit follows the time actually delivered under the payer program's own unit-counting method:

1. **CMS 8-minute rule, for a visit other than an evaluation or re-evaluation:** the rate is multiplied by the whole timed units the minutes delivered come to divided by the whole timed units the full slot length comes to. A number of minutes comes to whole timed units by adding half the minutes in one timed unit (7.5 of the 15 minutes in a timed unit), dividing by the 15 minutes in one timed unit and dropping any fraction.
2. **AMA substantial-portion method, for a visit other than an evaluation or re-evaluation:** the rate is multiplied by the minutes delivered divided by the slot length.
3. In either case the ratio is rounded half up to four decimal places.
4. **An evaluation or re-evaluation visit, or any other counting method:** the rate is charged in full (a ratio of 1).

| Payer program | Unit-counting method |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | AMA substantial-portion method |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | AMA substantial-portion method |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | AMA substantial-portion method |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | AMA substantial-portion method |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | CMS 8-minute rule |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | CMS 8-minute rule |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | CMS 8-minute rule |

## Whole timed units (15-minute unit)

| Minutes | Plus 7.5, divided by 15 | Whole timed units |
|---|---|---|
| 22 | 1.9667 | 1 |
| 23 | 2.0333 | 2 |
| 37 | 2.9667 | 2 |
| 45 | 3.5 | 3 |

## Worked ratio (hypothetical treatment visit, 45-minute slot, 37 minutes delivered)

- *CMS 8-minute rule:* 37 minutes come to 2 whole units and the 45-minute slot to 3, so the ratio is 2 divided by 3, 0.6667 to four places.
- *AMA substantial-portion method:* 37 divided by 45 is 0.82222…, so the ratio is 0.8222.
- *The same visit billed as a re-evaluation:* ratio 1 under either method.
